rules.x_world_measured: that centroid back-projected through the frame's camera (manifest) onto the vertical plane of the dog's line Z = -0.30 m; metres along the porch
rules.facing: +1 muzzle (red) left of skull (blue) on screen = toward the door; −1 away
rules.head_below_back: top of head pixels lower than the 2nd-percentile top of body pixels
rules.state: refuse if facing −1; else lie_down if lying; else approach/retreat if |vx| > 0.6 px/frame (retreat also needs head below back); else watch
rules.onsets: each state change walked back while the producing movement is active (muzzle turning > 2.5°/frame, height falling > 0.4 px/frame, |vx| > 0.15 px/frame)

onsets.rule: lying, head top rises > 4 px above its 26.0 s height
